articles.title: Norris admits Sprint mistake, ‘should never have attempted’ move on Piastri
articles.summary: Norris admits Sprint mistake, ‘should never have attempted’ move on Piastri. Lando Norris says he let McLaren down and should never have attempted his overtaking move on Oscar Piastri that resulted in the pair colliding in the Sprint at the Singapore Grand Prix.

articles.summary: Hamilton apologizes to Ferrari for strategy call. “Sorry, boys, I let you down today with that strategy,” Hamilton said on team radio. “My call, and I lost us valuable  points.”

articles.title: Verstappen breezes to first Singapore GP win as Antonelli brings title within reach
articles.summary: Verstappen breezes to first Singapore GP win as Antonelli brings title within reach. Max Verstappen claimed his first Singapore Grand Prix victory with a dominant performance that easily dispatched his closest pursuer, Ferrari’s Charles Leclerc.

articles.summary: Stella gets serious with McLaren drivers after Singapore collision. When Lando Norris attempted to overtake teammate Oscar Piastri on the final lap of the Singapore Sprint and the result was two spinning McLarens, it put team principal Andrea Stella in a tough spot. articles.title: Pole box checked, Verstappen is focusing on Singapore getaway
articles.summary: Pole box checked, Verstappen is focusing on Singapore getaway. Max Verstappen says his pole position for the Singapore Grand Prix was the result he wanted the most on Saturday despite winning the Sprint, but is still concerned about his run of poor starts.

articles.summary: Hamilton apologises to Ferrari as Antonelli moves to brink of title. Lewis Hamilton's incorrect strategy call during the Singapore Grand Prix means Kimi Antonelli can win the world title at the next race in Austin.

articles.summary: Do things change for 'Mr Consistent' Antonelli as he nears title?. The Chequered Flag's Harry Benjamin, Alice Powell and Alisha Palmowski discuss whether anything changes for Kimi Antonelli as the championship leader closes in on the title.
